projects.name: Stroke Risk Prediction Using Machine Learning
bullets: Developed a machine learning-based stroke risk prediction system using a biomedical dataset of 5,110 patient records and 12 attributes.
Built a data pipeline including Kaggle data ingestion, Pandas preprocessing, categorical encoding, SMOTE class balancing, and model evaluation.
Compared seven classification models, including Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Gaussian Naive Bayes, SVM, Random Forest, XGBoost, and LightGBM.
Analyzed key stroke-related features such as age, hypertension, heart disease, BMI, and average glucose level to support early risk screening.

projects.name: Spotify Vietnam Chart Analysis & Weekly Streams Prediction
bullets: Analyzed 2,400 Spotify Vietnam Top 200 observations across 12 weeks to identify trends in streams, rankings, artists, and genres.
Performed data cleaning, feature engineering, exploratory data analysis (EDA), and visualization using Python, Pandas, and Matplotlib.
Built and compared Baseline, Linear Regression, and Random Forest models for next-week stream prediction, with Linear Regression achieving the best performance (R² = 0.946).

projects.name: Forecasting Vietnam's Transportation CPI Using Macroeconomic Factors
bullets: Analyzed Vietnam's Transportation CPI from 2012 to 2024 and its relationship with macroeconomic factors.
Performed data preprocessing, exploratory data analysis, correlation analysis, and time-series stationarity testing.
Investigated the impact and lagged effects of fuel prices, crude oil prices, and exchange rates on Transportation CPI.
Developed and evaluated time-series forecasting models to predict future CPI movements.
